verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region or residency is a fair question for a cloud remote-access and IT-management SaaS like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers data region selection, residency options or storage location controls. The pack covers pricing features (SSO, audit log, mass deployment, AI assistants) and unrelated community complaints only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
